name: Rational
desc: You always use logic to think through problems and act only after planning.

name: Fickle
desc: Goals are unstable; you will not stick to a single goal for long.

name: Lazy
desc: You always procrastinate, don't want to work hard, and are more keen on enjoying life.

name: Adventurous
desc: You always take risks, love excitement, and always want to give it your all.

name: Casual
desc: You always adapt to circumstances; wherever your mood goes, you follow, with no fixed rules.

name: Greedy
desc: You have a strong desire for spirit stones and wealth.

name: Gatherer
desc: Likes to find various strange flowers, herbs, and spiritual medicines in mountains and forests.

name: Hunter
desc: Enjoys the excitement of tracking prey in the wild, knows the habits of various animals well.

name: Pensive
desc: You always think deeply, and your approach to problems is more philosophical.

name: Life-cherishing
desc: You always value your own life and will not take risks easily.

name: Friendly
desc: You value companions and harmony, are helpful.

name: Vengeful
desc: You never easily let go of a grudge and are willing to pay the price and time for revenge.

name: Aloof
desc: You prefer being alone, avoid deep involvement with others.

name: Indifferent
desc: You are emotionally restrained, calm and detached from the outside world.

name: Aggressive
desc: You face conflicts directly, prefer resolving problems through power and confrontation.

name: Rash
desc: You act impulsively with little regard for consequences.

name: Timid
desc: You are cautious and meticulous, easily afraid of risks.

name: Overbearing
desc: You act strongly and unreasonably, habitually putting your own interests first.

name: Cultivation Obsessed
desc: You spend the vast majority of your time on cultivation.

name: Introverted
desc: You enjoy solitude and self-reflection more.

name: Extroverted
desc: You enjoy communicating with others, proactively making friends.

name: Mean
desc: In dialogue, you tend to express yourself through irony, mockery, and sarcasm.

name: Enthusiastic
desc: You are friendly to others and respond positively.

name: Extremely Righteous
desc: You have a deep-seated hatred for evil.

name: Extremely Evil
desc: You promote power and fear, stop at nothing to achieve your goals.

name: Open-minded
desc: You are relatively casual about becoming Dao companions or dual cultivating with others.

name: Shy
desc: You are relatively cautious about becoming Dao companions or dual cultivating with others.

name: Simp
desc: You are exceptionally friendly to those of the opposite sex with outstanding appearance.

name: Envious
desc: You easily harbor hostility towards those who far exceed you.

name: Sword Fanatic
desc: Entering the Dao through the sword, the sword is your life.

name: Scheming
desc: Hiding your true self, acting cautiously, and good at calculating.

name: Loyal
desc: Values promises and integrity, never betrays the person you've acknowledged.

name: Ruthless
desc: Acts decisively and ruthlessly, leaving no future troubles.

name: Suspicious
desc: Maintains suspicion towards anyone, does not easily trust.

name: Body Cultivator
desc: Focuses on Body Tempering, with a strong physique and invincible close-quarters combat.

name: Alchemist
desc: Proficient in the Way of Alchemy, sensitive to spiritual herbs.

name: Sword Cultivator
desc: Possesses a deep interest and unique talent for the Way of the Sword.

name: Saber Cultivator
desc: Specializes in saber techniques, with a unique understanding of the Way of the Saber.

name: Spear Cultivator
desc: Proficient in spear techniques; with the king of all weapons in hand.

name: Staff Cultivator
desc: With a staff in hand, the world is mine.

name: Musical Master
desc: Proficient in the Way of Music; with a zither or flute in hand.

name: Lustful

name: Explorer

name: Homebody

name: Artifact Refiner
desc: Proficient in the Way of Artifact Refining.

name: Emotional
desc: Your emotions fluctuate greatly.

name: Miner
desc: Good at prospecting and digging, with a unique intuition for lodes.

name: Steady
desc: You avoid risks and the spotlight.

name: Envious
desc: Narrow-minded, unable to see others doing better than yourself.

name: Family-oriented
desc: You value family and blood relationships, putting family interests first.

name: Righteous
desc: You value friendship and loyalty, willing to go to great lengths for your friends.

name: Friendless
desc: You are accustomed to being alone, not easily forming deep connections with others.

name: Devoted
desc: You are devoted in love, once committed, you will not change.

name: Romantic
desc: You are easily moved by emotions, full of longing for beautiful feelings.

name: Heartless
desc: You are indifferent to emotions, not easily moved.

name: Playful
desc: Indulging in fun, not thinking about progress.

name: Bookworm
desc: Addicted to books.

name: Tea Lover
desc: Can't go a day without tea.

name: Musician
desc: Good at playing the zither.

name: Traveler
desc: Reading ten thousand books is not as good as traveling ten thousand miles.

name: Chess Player
desc: Good chess players live long.

name: Farmer
desc: Coming from the bottom of society, you have a knack for spirit plant cultivation and can earn more spirit stones from farming.

name: Detached
desc: You keep your distance from worldly affairs and dislike being drawn into mundane power and court business.

name: Reclusive Cultivator
desc: You are used to cultivating alone among mountains and marshes, and nothing annoys you more than dealings with the court.

name: Worldly
desc: You are willing to step into the mortal world and temper yourself and your reputation through worldly affairs.

name: Orthodox Gentleman
desc: You revere orthodox order and gladly use scholarship and public service to bring order to the world.

name: Beauty-Conscious
desc: You care a lot about your appearance and spend effort grooming yourself so you look more presentable.

name: Self-Adoring
desc: You care intensely about your appearance and almost treat becoming better-looking as an obsession.

name: Play Weak, Hide Strong
desc: You habitually hide your edge and feign weakness, so others often misjudge your strength and how dangerous you really are. Some even bully or humiliate you, only to be spectacularly put in their place.

name: Kin to Outsiders
desc: You have a natural curiosity and affinity toward cultivators of other races, and are willing to build relationships across differences of origin.

name: Hates Outsiders
desc: You instinctively reject cultivators of races different from your own, and find it hard to truly trust outsiders.

name: Gu Master
desc: Skilled in insects and poison arts, and adept at cultivating through Gu.

name: Gu Immortal
desc: Naturally attuned to myriad Gu, able to command insects with a thought.

name: Formation Master
desc: Understands formation structures and can use formation disks to guide regional spiritual mechanisms.

name: Formation Immortal
desc: Born with mastery of formation arts, able to draw ley lines and spiritual mechanisms more efficiently when setting formations.
